topic: External Light Control System - Direction Light Control
row_semantics: The table describes parameters related to the control and status of direction lights in a vehicle's exterior lighting system.
column_semantics: The columns represent different aspects of the parameter: the first column is the parameter name, the second column specifies the data type or interface (e.g., output, consumption), and subsequent columns list the relevant controllers/modules that interact with this parameter.

core_entities.name: DircnLightSts
core_entities.description: Current state of the direction lights (on/off, left/right, both sides)

core_entities.name: DircnLightFltsts
core_entities.description: Fault status of the direction lights

core_entities.name: ControlDirectionLight
core_entities.description: Method to control the direction lights (on/off, flash)

core_outputs.name: DircnLightSts
core_outputs.description: Indicates whether the direction lights are off, on for the left side, right side, or both sides.

core_outputs.name: DircnLightFltsts
core_outputs.description: Indicates if there are any errors in the direction lights, such as no error, left side error, right side error, or both sides error.

core_faults.name: DircnLightFltsts_1_Left_Direction_Light_Error
core_faults.description: Error condition for the left direction light.

core_faults.name: DircnLightFltsts_2_Right_Direction_Light_Error
core_faults.description: Error condition for the right direction light.

core_faults.name: DircnLightFltsts_3_Both_Side_Direction_Light_Error
core_faults.description: Error condition for both direction lights.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the parameters and methods used to control and monitor the direction lights in a vehicle's exterior lighting system. It can be used to verify the correct operation of direction light control logic, fault detection, and response across various controllers/modules.
